name: 5-4-3-2-1 Senses
steps: Name 5 things you can see, 4 you can touch, 3 you can hear, 2 you can smell, 1 you can taste.
bestFor: Sudden anxiety spikes, dissociation, racing thoughts

name: Body Scan
steps: Slowly bring attention from your toes to your head, noticing sensation without judgment in each area.
bestFor: Disconnected from body, tension, pre-sleep wind-down

name: Cold Water Reset
steps: Splash cool water on your face or hold a cool object, focusing fully on the sensation.
bestFor: Panic escalation, needing a fast physiological reset

name: Feet on the Floor
steps: Press both feet firmly into the ground and notice the pressure and contact points.
bestFor: Feeling ungrounded, spacey, or panicked in public

name: Category Naming
steps: Pick a category (fruits, cities, songs) and name as many as you can in one minute.

name: Object Study
steps: Pick up a nearby object and describe its texture, weight, color, and temperature in detail.

name: Counting Backward
steps: Count backward from 100 by 7s (or any interval), focusing only on the numbers.

name: Naming the Room
steps: Silently list 10 objects you can see around you right now.
bestFor: Anxiety in unfamiliar or overwhelming spaces

name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
steps: Tense a muscle group for 5 seconds, then release, moving from feet to head.

name: Anchor Phrase
steps: Repeat a short grounding phrase like 'I am here, I am safe right now' while breathing slowly.

name: Texture Walk
steps: Notice the texture of your clothing, chair, or nearby fabric with your fingertips.

name: Temperature Awareness
steps: Notice the temperature of the air on your skin, and any warm or cool spots around you.

name: Sound Mapping
steps: Close your eyes and identify the closest sound, then the farthest sound you can hear.

name: Weighted Comfort
steps: Hold a pillow, blanket, or place a hand firmly on your chest and notice the pressure.

name: Slow Walk Awareness
steps: Walk slowly and narrate each physical movement internally: 'lifting, moving, placing'.
bestFor: Restlessness, needing to move while grounding
